161295cf.yl: Yield: 1 gammon 5 kg bone-in → ≈ 3.3 kg carved · 22 portions × 150 g
c: Soak overnight in cold water (change once) to remove excess salt.
Cover with fresh water, onion, carrots, bay and peppercorns; simmer gently (85–90 °C) 25 min/kg ≈ 2 h; core 68 °C.
Cool 30 min in the liquor; remove skin, leaving 5 mm fat; score fat in 2 cm diamonds.
Stud diamond centres with cloves; mix the glaze.
Roast 200 °C 25–30 min, glazing every 8 min, until lacquered and caramelised; core ≥ 72 °C.
Rest 20 min; carve thin slices against the bone.
161295cf.st: 0–4 °C 5 days; serve cold or warm. Carving station ≥ 63 °C max 2 h.

b06cb6d4.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 100 g beef · 1 slice rye · 10 g mustard · 20 g gherkin
c: Boil water with salt, sugar and spices; cool to 4 °C; add curing salt.
Submerge brisket (weighted); cure 0–4 °C 7 days, turning daily.
Rinse brisket; cover with fresh cold water and the vegetables.
Simmer 85–90 °C 3–3.5 h until a skewer slides in easily.
Hold in the liquid; slice to order 5 mm across the grain.
Serve beef on rye with mustard and sliced gherkins.
b06cb6d4.st: Cooked beef in liquid 0–4 °C 5 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.

86b15a35.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 110 g beef · 15 g chimichurri · 30 g vinagrete
c: Cut caps with the grain into 3 cm steaks; fold into a C with fat outside; skewer 3–4 per skewer.
Coat with rock salt; grill fat side to the flame first, then rotate over medium heat to core 52 °C.
Rest 5 min; shake off salt; slice thin off the skewer to order; return skewer to the grill.
Chop herbs and garlic fine by hand; mix with vinegar, chilli and salt; add oil; rest 1 h.
Dice vegetables 5 mm; dress with vinegar, oil, salt and parsley; chill.
86b15a35.st: Raw skewers 0–4 °C 24 h. Sauces 0–4 °C 48 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
86b15a35.al: 14 Sulphites (red wine vinegar, white wine vinegar)

b78d3e40.yl: Yield: 4 kg raw → ≈ 2.8 kg (−30%) · 18 portions × 150 g
c: Toast fennel seeds 1 min; crush with pepper; chop with garlic, herbs, zest and chilli; mix with oil.
Score belly flesh in a 2 cm grid; salt both meats; spread herb paste; lay loin on belly and roll tight; tie every 3 cm.
Dry the skin uncovered 0–4 °C overnight; rub skin with salt.
Roast 150 °C 3 h to core 68 °C; then 240 °C 15–20 min until the crackling blisters.
Rest 20 min; carve 1.5 cm slices; serve warm or cold in rolls.
b78d3e40.st: 0–4 °C 4 days; serve cold or warm (carving lamp ≥ 63 °C max 2 h).

c9f0479c.yl: Yield: 3 kg striploin → ≈ 2.4 kg (−20%) · 16 portions × 150 g + 1 Yorkshire
c: Score fat; season heavily 1 h before; sear fat side and all sides 8 min in a hot pan.
Brush with mustard; roast on a rack 160 °C convection to core 52 °C for medium-rare (≈ 60–70 min), 58 °C medium.
Rest 25 min (core rises 3–4 °C); carve 5 mm slices at the station; serve with gravy and horseradish.
Whisk eggs, milk, flour and salt to a smooth batter; rest 1 h (or overnight 0–4 °C).
Heat 5 g oil per mould at 230 °C until smoking; pour batter ⅓ full quickly.
Bake 220 °C 20–22 min without opening the door until tall and crisp.
c9f0479c.st: Beef 0–4 °C 3 days. Yorkshires best fresh; refresh 200 °C 3 min.
c9f0479c.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard)

59d4eb61.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 120 g beef · 40 ml jus · 15 g horseradish cream
c: Temper joints 2 h; rub with salt, cracked pepper, crushed garlic, herbs and oil.
Sear 230 °C 20 min; roast 120 °C to core 52 °C (about 3–3.5 h).
Rest 30 min loosely covered (core rises to 55 °C); remove bones.
Carve to order 4 mm on a heated board under the lamp.
Sweat shallots in the roasting tray fat; add tomato paste 2 min.
Deglaze with wine; reduce by two thirds; add stock and thyme; reduce to 2 l.
Thicken lightly with slaked corn flour; strain; mount with cold butter.
Whip cream to soft peaks; fold in sour cream, horseradish, lemon and salt; chill.
59d4eb61.st: Cooked beef 0–4 °C 3 days. Jus 0–4 °C 4 days. Cream 0–4 °C 48 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
59d4eb61.al: 7 Milk (butter, sour cream 20%, cream 33%) · 9 Celery (beef stock) · 14 Sulphites (red wine)

c0153a16.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 110 g lamb · 25 g yoghurt · 1 pita
c: Make a paste of soft butter, garlic, spices and 90 g salt; rub into slashed shoulders; marinate 12 h.
Roast covered with the water 150 °C 5 h until the bone pulls free.
Uncover; baste; roast 220 °C 15 min to glaze.
Carve and pull to order; serve with cumin salt (20 g salt + 10 g toasted ground cumin).
Ripple harissa through seasoned yoghurt; finish with lemon and torn mint.
Brush with oil; warm on the plancha 30 s per side to order.
c0153a16.st: Cooked lamb 0–4 °C 3 days. Yoghurt 0–4 °C 48 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.

2178dd6c.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 130 g pork incl. crackling · 30 g apple sauce
c: Score skin 1 cm apart; dry uncovered in the fridge overnight.
Rub flesh with crushed fennel, pepper and garlic; salt the skin well.
Roast on sliced onions 230 °C 30 min until skin blisters; add cider; roast 150 °C 5–6 h to core 85 °C.
Rest 30 min; lift crackling and break into shards; carve meat to order.
Cook diced apples with butter, sugar and cider covered 15 min until soft.
Mash coarse; add lemon; serve warm or cold.
2178dd6c.st: Cooked pork 0–4 °C 3 days; crackling airtight, room temperature 24 h. Sauce 0–4 °C 5 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.

50be693f.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 95 g beef · 30 ml peppercorn sauce · 20 g béarnaise
c: Tie logs every 3 cm; season; sear all sides in oil; baste with butter, thyme and garlic.
Roast 180 °C to core 52 °C (about 25–30 min per log).
Rest 15 min; carve to order 1.5 cm slices.
Sweat shallots in butter; add crushed peppercorns; flame with brandy.
Add stock; reduce by half; add cream; simmer to coating consistency; season.
Reduce vinegar with shallots and tarragon stalks to 60 ml; strain.
Whisk yolks with reduction over a bain-marie to 70 °C ribbon.
Whisk in warm clarified butter slowly; add chopped tarragon; season. Hold 60–65 °C, max 2 h.
50be693f.st: Cooked beef 0–4 °C 3 days. Peppercorn sauce 0–4 °C 3 days. Béarnaise: make per service, discard after 2 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
50be693f.al: 3 Eggs (egg yolks) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%, clarified butter) · 9 Celery (beef stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine vinegar)

9054d9a8.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 85 g salmon · 25 g sauce
c: Pin-bone sides; salt 20 min; pat dry; place on lined trays.
Brush with mustard; press on crumb mixed with herbs, zest and melted butter.
Bake 160 °C to core 50 °C (about 20 min); rest 5 min.
Portion to order with a palette knife on a heated board.
9054d9a8.st: Cooked salmon 0–4 °C 48 h. Sauce 0–4 °C 48 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
9054d9a8.al: 1 Gluten (breadcrumbs) · 4 Fish (salmon fillet) · 7 Milk (butter, greek yoghurt 10%, sour cream 20%) · 10 Mustard (dijon mustard)

54e851fd.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 140 g cooked pasta · 80 g sauce · garnish
c: Cook 2 min short of al dente in salted water (10 g/l); refresh in iced water; drain; toss with oil; portion 140 g.
Soften garlic in oil; add tomatoes and salt; simmer 30 min; blend coarse; add basil.
Sauté mushrooms hard in butter; add shallots, garlic, thyme; deglaze with wine; add cream; simmer 5 min; finish with parmesan.
Blend basil, toasted pine nuts, garlic and salt with oil; fold in parmesan. Garnish: halved tomatoes, chilli, 400 g grated parmesan.
Pan per portion: 80 g sauce, 140 g pasta, splash of pasta water; toss 1–2 min; garnish to choice.
54e851fd.st: Par-cooked pasta 0–4 °C 48 h; sauces 0–4 °C 3 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
54e851fd.al: 1 Gluten (penne, egg tagliatelle) · 3 Eggs (egg tagliatelle) · 7 Milk (butter, cream 33%, parmesan) · 8 Nuts (pine nuts) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

c: Sweat diced onion in oil; toast rice 2 min; deglaze with wine.
Add hot stock gradually 12 min (60% cooked, firm centre).
Spread 2 cm on trays; chill to \<5 °C within 90 min; portion 150 g.
Soak porcini; chop; sauté with sliced mushrooms, garlic and thyme in butter until golden; add parsley.
Infuse saffron in hot stock 15 min.
Pan per portion: 150 g base + 110 ml hot stock; cook 4–5 min stirring (add 50 g mushrooms or 12 ml saffron stock).
Off the heat beat in 8 g cold butter and 12 g parmesan; rest 30 s; plate all'onda.
9b7dc321.st: Par-cooked base 0–4 °C 48 h. Mushroom finish 0–4 °C 3 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
9b7dc321.al: 7 Milk (butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

6bb60c16.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 160 g polenta · 75 g ragù
c: Bring water, milk and salt to the boil; rain in polenta whisking.
Cook on low 40 min stirring often until it leaves the sides.
Beat in butter and parmesan; hold loose in a bain-marie, adding hot water as it thickens.
Sauté mushrooms hard in batches; add shallots, garlic and thyme.
Deglaze with wine; add stock; reduce to a glossy ragù; add parsley.
Brown crumbled sausage; add onion, garlic, fennel and chilli 5 min.
Deglaze with wine; add passata; simmer 40 min until thick.
6bb60c16.st: Polenta: cook per service. Ragùs 0–4 °C 3 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
6bb60c16.al: 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, parmesan) · 9 Celery (vegetable stock) · 14 Sulphites (white wine, red wine)

c: Cook in batches of 5 portions 3–4 min al dente; toss with butter and a ladle of pasta water.
Flame 30 ml brandy in the wheel cavity for 30 s to soften the surface (or use a torch).
Tip the hot pasta into the wheel; scrape and toss 30–40 s until creamy (about 18 g cheese per portion).
Plate 180 g; finish with cracked pepper. Scrape the cavity smooth between batches; after service cover and refrigerate the wheel.
0af8ea6a.st: Cook to order only. Wheel wrapped 0–4 °C. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
0af8ea6a.al: 1 Gluten (egg tagliatelle) · 3 Eggs (egg tagliatelle) · 7 Milk (butter, parmesan)

c: Cut 3 cm cubes; marinate with all ingredients 6–12 h.
Skewer; grill or roast 230 °C 12–14 min to core 75 °C; char edges on the tawa.
Make soft dough; rest 30 min; divide 80 g; roll 20 cm with ghee layers.
Cook on tawa 1 min per side with ghee; stack under a cloth.
Blend herbs, chilli, lemon and salt; fold into yoghurt.
Slice onion thin; dress with lime and a pinch of salt.
Warm paratha on tawa; add 65 g chicken, onion, 12 g chutney; roll tight in paper.
ef3cccb2.st: Marinated chicken 0–4 °C 24 h. Chutney 0–4 °C 48 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.

c: Griddle to order, season, 2 min per side to core 72 °C; melt cheddar on top.
Cut 60 g pieces; marinate in buttermilk 4 h.
Dredge in seasoned flour; fry 170 °C 5–6 min to core 75 °C.
Slice 1 cm; griddle 1 min per side to order.
Burger sauce: mayo + ketchup + chopped gherkin.
Toast buns; build slider: sauce, lettuce, tomato, filling; pin with a skewer.
85fdb7a5.st: Raw patties 0–4 °C 24 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
85fdb7a5.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, brioche slider buns) · 3 Eggs (brioche slider buns, mayonnaise) · 7 Milk (cheddar, buttermilk, halloumi, brioche slider buns)

d72a01fc.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 1 sausage 100 g · 60 g sauerkraut · 30 g curry sauce · 1 pretzel
c: Poach 75 °C 10 min (optional, faster service); grill to order until browned, core 72 °C.
For currywurst slice 2 cm and top with sauce and curry powder.
Sweat diced onion; add curry powder and paprika 1 min.
Add ketchup, apple juice and vinegar; simmer 10 min; blend smooth.
Sweat onion; add grated apple, rinsed sauerkraut, caraway, bay and wine.
Warm pretzels 160 °C 4 min; serve with mustard.
d72a01fc.st: Sauerkraut 0–4 °C 5 days. Curry sauce 0–4 °C 1 week. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
d72a01fc.al: 1 Gluten (soft pretzels) · 10 Mustard (curry powder, wholegrain mustard) · 14 Sulphites (white wine)

c: Knead smooth; prove 1 h. Divide 48 g; roll ovals; oil; fold over baking paper; prove 30 min.
Steam 10 min; re-steam 2 min to order.
Blanch belly 5 min; cut 4 cm blocks. Caramelise sugar; add pork, soy, wine, aromatics, water; braise covered 150 °C 2 h.
Chill in liquor; slice 1 cm; glaze in reduced liquor to order.
Pickle sliced cucumber and carrot in vinegar, sugar and salt 1 h.
Fill bao: 30 g pork, 5 g hoisin, pickles, crushed peanuts, coriander.
1a677eed.st: Steamed bao 0–4 °C 48 h; freeze 1 month. Braised pork 0–4 °C 3 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
1a677eed.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour, soy sauce, shaoxing wine, hoisin sauce) · 5 Peanuts (peanuts) · 6 Soybeans (soy sauce, hoisin sauce) · 11 Sesame (hoisin sauce) · 14 Sulphites (shaoxing wine)

b8e4f5e7.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: ½ gözleme ≈ 190 g
c: Knead to a soft dough 8 min; divide 190 g balls; oil; rest covered 1 h.
Wilt spinach; squeeze very dry; chop; mix with sweated onion, crumbled feta, parsley and pepper.
Cook onion and lamb until dry; add tomato paste and spices 3 min; add parsley; cool.
Roll dough paper-thin 60 cm; fill half with 160 g filling; fold and seal.
Cook on griddle 200 °C 2–3 min per side, brushing with butter.
Cut in half and in strips; serve with lemon.
b8e4f5e7.st: Fillings 0–4 °C 48 h. Dough balls 0–4 °C 24 h. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.

bdebc54c.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: ≈145 g grilled meat · 30 g sauce
c: Cut striploin into 1.5 cm steaks; marinate chicken with paprika, garlic and lemon; lamb with rosemary and oil (2–12 h).
Season with salt just before grilling.
Grill to order: beef core 55 °C, lamb 58 °C, chicken 75 °C; rest 2 min; slice beef.
Beat butter with garlic, herbs, zest and salt; roll in film; chill; slice 10 g discs.
Serve BBQ sauce at room temperature.
Mix yoghurt with chopped mint, garlic and salt; chill.
bdebc54c.st: Marinated raw meat 0–4 °C 24 h. Butter 0–4 °C 1 week. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.

d49fff43.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 250 ml broth · 150 g ingredients · 30 g dip
c: Clear: simmer 7.5 l stock with 100 g sliced ginger, spring onion and salt 20 min.
Sichuan: fry doubanjiang in oil 3 min; add chillies, peppercorns, garlic, 80 g ginger 2 min; add 6 l stock; simmer 30 min.
Semi-freeze beef; slice 2 mm. Soak noodles 10 min; cut vegetables bite-size; display on ice by type.
Whisk tahini with soy, vinegar, sugar, garlic and water to a pourable dip; top with chilli oil and spring onion.
Guest fills a basket; cook in boiling broth: vegetables 1–2 min, beef 20 s, prawns 2 min.
Serve in a bowl with 250 ml broth; dip on the side.
d49fff43.st: Sliced raw beef and prawns 0–4 °C 24 h. Broths 0–4 °C 3 days. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C.
d49fff43.al: 1 Gluten (doubanjiang, soy sauce) · 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 6 Soybeans (firm tofu, soy sauce) · 9 Celery (chicken stock) · 11 Sesame (tahini)

28222f9b.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 120 g noodles · 90 g protein · 100 g vegetables · 25 g sauce
c: Slice chicken and beef 5 mm; marinate with soy and corn flour 30 min. Cube tofu 2 cm. Keep each protein in its own chilled insert.
Cut pak choi in quarters, carrot and pepper in strips, shiitake sliced, spring onion 3 cm.
Simmer all except sesame oil 3 min; thicken lightly; add sesame oil; cool.
Very hot wok: 10 ml oil, protein 90 g 1–2 min (core 75 °C for chicken).
Add vegetables 100 g 1 min, noodles 120 g, sauce 25 g; toss 1 min.
28222f9b.st: Raw proteins 0–4 °C 24 h. Sauce 0–4 °C 2 weeks. Hold hot food ≥63 °C, max 2 h on the station; cold sauces ≤5 °C. Keep prawns and tofu tongs separate.
28222f9b.al: 1 Gluten (soy sauce, oyster sauce, egg noodles) · 2 Crustaceans (black tiger prawns) · 3 Eggs (egg noodles) · 6 Soybeans (firm tofu, soy sauce, oyster sauce) · 11 Sesame (sesame oil) · 12 Molluscs (oyster sauce)

98bbb1ac.yl: Yield: 10 portions (5 platters for two) · Portion: ½ platter ≈ 550 g (shell-on, main)
c: Freeze 48 h, thaw at 0–4 °C; remove beak and eyes.
Simmer gently with bay and salt 45–60 min until tender; cool in the liquid.
Beat soft butter with crushed garlic, chilli, chopped coriander, lime and salt.
Tomato concassé 5 mm; shallot and ginger brunoise; chopped coriander and chilli.
Mix with olive oil, lime and salt; warm to 50 °C at service only.
Chill lobsters 20 min in ice water; split lengthwise; remove the intestine; brush with chilli-garlic butter.
Grill lobster shell side down over hot charcoal 6–7 min, flesh side 1–2 min (core 60 °C).
Oil and grill octopus tentacles 2–3 min per side until charred.
Grill fish (5 × 200 g) skin side 4 min, flip 2 min (core 60 °C); prawns 2 min per side.
Arrange on a board per two guests with charred lime; vierge and remaining butter in dishes.
98bbb1ac.st: Seafood raw: 0–2 °C on ice, 24 h. Octopus cooked: 0–4 °C, 48 h. Butter: 0–4 °C, 5 days.
98bbb1ac.al: 2 Crustaceans (spiny lobster, tiger prawns) · 4 Fish (grouper / job fish fillet) · 7 Milk (butter) · 12 Molluscs (octopus)

b3f924bd.yl: Yield: 10 omelettes · Portion: ≈ 170 g (3 eggs + 40 g fillings)
c: Crack, whisk with salt and pepper; strain; keep in a jug on ice (≤ 5 °C), max 2 h at the station.
Per omelette: 5 g butter in a 20 cm non-stick pan, medium heat; add 150 g mix.
Stir 20 s, then let set 40–60 s; add fillings in the centre; fold in thirds; plate seam down.
Mise en place for 10 · ≈ 400 g, guest choice
Dice ham, cheese and peppers 5 mm; slice mushrooms and sauté 3 min; dice onion and sauté until soft.
Quarter tomatoes; wash spinach; chop parsley. Each filling in its own labelled bowl on ice.
Separate utensils per filling; ask every guest about allergies before cooking.
b3f924bd.st: Egg mix ≤ 5 °C, use within 2 h at the station; leftovers discarded. Fillings 0–4 °C, 24 h.
b3f924bd.al: 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (butter, kashkaval). Allergens shown for the full filling set; cook a plain omelette in a clean pan for allergy guests.

7b5e3228.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: ≈45 g chocolate · 120 g dippers
c: Melt chocolates to 45 °C; stir in oil until fluid.
Pre-warm the fountain 10 min; pour in; run at 45 °C. Discard leftover chocolate after service.
Hull strawberries; cut pineapple 3 cm; slice banana 2 cm and toss in lemon juice.
Arrange on skewers or with picks; refresh fruit every 30 min.
7b5e3228.al: 1 Gluten (shortbread biscuits) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%, milk chocolate 35%) · 7 Milk (milk chocolate 35%, shortbread biscuits)

eef1f98e.yl: Yield: 10 portions × 3 crêpes · Portion: ≈ 130 g (75 g crêpes + 55 g sauce)
c: Blend milk, eggs, flour, sugar and salt; add melted butter; rest 1 h at 0–4 °C.
Cook in a lightly buttered pan, 45 g batter each, 40 s per side; stack between paper.
Caramelise the sugar to light amber; add butter, then orange juice, zest and lemon; reduce by ⅓ to a light syrup.
Per portion: warm 55 g sauce in a pan; add 3 crêpes folded in quarters; baste 1 min.
Add orange liqueur and brandy; flambé (away from the extraction hood); serve at once with orange segments.
eef1f98e.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter). Contains alcohol (largely burnt off when flambéed).

c: Whisk flours, yeast, sugar and salt with warm milk (35 °C), eggs and butter to a smooth batter.
Butter a hot poffertjes pan; fill each cup ¾ (5 g); cook 1 min until set at the edges; flip with a fork 40 s.
Serve 12 per plate with 10 g butter and a heavy dusting of icing sugar.

0a30c7da.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 100 g ice cream · 20 g sauce · 20 g toppings · 20 g cream
c: Temper tubs at −12 °C before service; scoop with a hot scoop; keep in a chilled well.
Fudge: boil 500 g cream, 100 g sugar, glucose; pour over chocolate; emulsify with 60 g butter; serve 45 °C.
Caramel: cook 600 g sugar to amber; add 450 g hot cream; boil 1 min; add 120 g butter and salt.
Coulis: simmer berries, 160 g sugar, lemon 5 min; blend; strain.
Toast hazelnuts; set toppings in bowls.
Whip cream with sugar and vanilla to soft peaks; pipe to order.
0a30c7da.st: Ice cream −18 °C. Sauces 0–4 °C 1 week (fudge, caramel), coulis 3 days. Station max 2 h.
0a30c7da.al: 1 Gluten (feuilletine) · 3 Eggs (vanilla ice cream) · 6 Soybeans (dark chocolate 54%) · 7 Milk (vanilla ice cream, chocolate ice cream, cream 33%, butter, feuilletine, dark chocolate 54%, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (hazelnuts)

04330e6e.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 1 crêpe 75 g · 60 g filling
c: Whisk flour, sugar, salt, eggs and half the milk smooth; add remaining milk and butter.
Slice bananas to order; cut lemons in wedges.
Whip cream with 60 g icing sugar; keep chilled.
Butter a hot crêpe plate 200 °C; spread 75 g batter thin; cook 40 s, turn 20 s.
Fill to choice, fold in four; dust with icing sugar.
04330e6e.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, hazelnut cocoa spread, cream 35%) · 8 Nuts (hazelnut cocoa spread)

f0016181.yl: Yield: 50 guests (station) · Portion: 1 waffle 90 g · 40 g toppings
c: Mix flour, warm milk, eggs, yeast, sugar, salt and vanilla 8 min; add butter gradually to a smooth dough.
Prove 1 h; fold in pearl sugar; divide 95 g; prove 20 min.
Whip cream with half the icing sugar; set berries and spread in inserts.
Cook in a cast-iron waffle iron 180 °C 3–4 min until the sugar caramelises.
Serve with toppings of choice; dust with icing sugar.
f0016181.st: Dough balls 0–4 °C 24 h; freeze 1 month. Station max 2 h.
f0016181.al: 1 Gluten (wheat flour) · 3 Eggs (eggs) · 7 Milk (milk 3%, butter, cream 35%, hazelnut cocoa spread) · 8 Nuts (hazelnut cocoa spread)

c: Rub butter into dry ingredients; bind with honey and milk; chill 1 h.
Roll 3 mm; cut 6 cm squares; dock.
Guests toast marshmallows on skewers over the burner (staff supervised).
Sandwich: biscuit, 8 g chocolate, hot marshmallow, biscuit; press lightly.
fd2c74c2.st: Biscuits airtight 1 week. Station max 2 h; supervise open flame.
fd2c74c2.al: 1 Gluten (wholemeal flour, wheat flour) · 6 Soybeans (milk chocolate 35%) · 7 Milk (butter, milk 3%, milk chocolate 35%)
